description: Implementation of the LimitedAxesImuSensor class for handling limited axes IMU sensors in Android, including sensor type conversions, processing sensor events, and activating/deactivating sensors.

classes.name: LimitedAxesImuSensor
classes.description: A sensor class that provides limited axes IMU sensor functionality, including processing events, activation, delay setting, and sensor type conversions.

methods.name: LimitedAxesImuSensor
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the sensor based on a list of sensors and a specific IMU sensor type.

methods.name: process
methods.description: Processes incoming sensor events, modifies data for limited axes, and updates event metadata.

methods.name: setDelay
methods.description: Sets the delay (sampling rate) for the sensor.

methods.name: convertImu3dToLimitedAxesSensorType
methods.description: Converts a 3D IMU sensor type to a limited axes sensor type.

methods.name: convertLimitedAxesSensorTypeToHandle
methods.description: Converts a limited axes sensor type to a handle identifier.

methods.name: convertLimitedAxesSensorTypeToName
methods.description: Converts a limited axes sensor type to its descriptive name.
